title: Parts Department ON exposes exactly 3 child CRUD cards
expected: Exactly 3 child CRUD cards (Part sales, Catalog and Inventory, Vendor and order management) each View/Create&Edit/Delete
actual: Toggled Parts Department ON; exactly 3 child cards appeared with correct titles/descriptions and View/Create&Edit/Delete columns

title: Parts Department parent OFF hides the 3 child cards
expected: 3 child sub-cards no longer visible inside Parts Department card
actual: After toggling Parts Department OFF, all 3 child sub-cards were hidden

title: Toggling Parts Department OFF then ON PRESERVES the 3 child CRUD selections
expected: After OFF then ON, all 9 child checkboxes restored to previous selection
actual: Set 6 of 9 checkboxes; OFF hid them; ON restored all 9 states exactly (PRESERVED=true)

title: Parts Department OFF in saved role hides Parts top-nav and inner pages
expected: 'Parts' not in top nav; Part sales/Catalog/Vendor pages not reachable
actual: Tech top-nav had only 'Work Orders'; /parts/part-sales redirected to /workorders

title: Part sales View grants part sales records read access
expected: Part sales page loads; records visible; no create/edit/delete affordances
actual: Part Sales page loaded with 9 records incl Total Price (SFD on); no create button, no kebab, no edit/delete affordances

title: Catalog and Inventory View grants catalog and inventory read access
expected: All views load; no edit/delete affordances
actual: Catalog (32 entries) and Inventory (32 rows, levels) loaded read-only; no create/edit/delete buttons or kebab

title: Vendor and order management View grants vendor / PO / delivery visibility
expected: All views load; no edit/delete affordances
actual: Vendors page (32 records) + Purchase Orders/Vendor Invoices/Returns tabs loaded read-only; no create/edit/delete/receive buttons or kebab

title: Catalog and Inventory Create and Edit enables create / edit / inventory adjustments (cost and price fields gated by See Financial Data)
role_used: ZZAUTOTEST (catalogInventoryView+CreateAndEdit; SFD toggled ON then OFF)
expected: Create/edit/adjust succeed; cost&price visible+editable with SFD ON, hidden with SFD OFF
actual: New Catalog Part save -> POST add-catalogue-part 201; edit form present; SFD ON showed Average Cost/Sell Price columns+fields; SFD OFF removed them; item still creatable
